h1: Custom Fleece Shorts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom fleece shorts in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for lounging or casual wear. Get your brand noticed today.
introHtml: Fleece shorts offer a soft, warm alternative to standard cotton or athletic shorts, making them a top pick for company giveaways at winter retreats, holiday parties, or outdoor team-building events. The brushed interior provides extra comfort while the durable fabric holds up to screen printing or embroidery. Whether you are outfitting staff for a casual Friday or creating a cozy promotional item, custom fleece shorts keep your brand visible in a relaxed setting.
heroAltText: Custom fleece shorts with embroidered logo on the leg, ideal for corporate giveaways and team uniforms.
